observations: Read and looked at assets/panels/05-1.png, assets/characters/main-cast.png, workflow/review/page-05.png and workflow/quality/sheets/page-05-faces-200.png. I did not open the source text, storyboards/page-05.svg or the vision, nurse or check-in sheets. None of those characters appear in this panel.

Identity: Ananya matches the sheet. She has a low bun with loose strands, a gold stud on her visible ear, almond eyes with heavy lids, level brows and a pointed oval chin, and wears a teal kurta under an open white coat with the stethoscope around her neck, not in use. Ravi matches too: side-parted short black hair, trimmed beard, thick straight brows and a square jaw, in a light green shirt with a chest pocket and rolled sleeves, plus dark trousers.

Hands match the production plan. Ananya's left hand is an open palm extended toward Ravi and her right hand rests flat on the desk beside the laptop. Ravi's left hand grips the chair armrest with the wristwatch visible on that left wrist, and his right hand rests on his knee.

Props: the laptop stands in the left foreground and fills about 45% of the width. It shows six light cards in a column: heart, clock/history, yellow warning triangle, a microphone with a grey toggle that is OFF, a document and a purple flask. Every card has blank grey bars. There are no letters, numbers or real data, and nothing suggests a diagnosis. No tablet is visible. The dark-brown shoulder bag sits beside Ravi's chair at the lower right edge and nothing is on his shoulder, which matches 'set down beside the chair'.
Acting: Ananya is mid-speech with a warm smile, turned toward Ravi. Ravi smiles and glances back at her as he settles in. Plain wall across the top right holds the balloon in the composite.

Non-blocking staging note: the laptop screen faces the reader almost head-on, so Ananya sits behind its lid rather than at a true three-quarter angle. This follows the request's 'readable for the reader' convention and is repeated in 06-2. Her chair is a dark grey office chair here, which matters for the chair continuity noted in 05-2 and 06-2.
Read and looked at assets/panels/05-2.png (zoomed-out final), main-cast.png, page-05.png and the 05-2 crops on page-05-faces-200.png.

Final edit result: the figures sit in roughly the lower half of the panel, and the upper half is plain off-white wall with a window at the far left. In page-05.png the three balloons and labels fill that wall without covering either face, the laptop or any hands. The figures are small, with faces about 50 px on the page, but the 200% sheet shows both faces are intact. Ananya keeps her bun, gold stud and almond eyes. Ravi keeps his beard, thick brows and side part, with no smearing from the zoom-out.

Bag-strap edit: no strap or remnant crosses Ravi's shoulder or chest, and the shirt line is clean. The floor is cropped out at his waist, so the bag on the floor is out of frame, which agrees with 05-1 and 06-2.

Hands: Ananya's left hand is an open palm gesturing toward the laptop and Ravi. Her right fingertips rest on the front of the laptop deck at the trackpad, which reads as ticking the box. Ravi's right hand is raised palm-up in agreement and his left hand rests on his knee with the wristwatch visible. All of this matches production.

Screen: one consent card with a microphone icon in a pale circle, a teal shield, a check box with a teal tick and small motion strokes showing it being ticked, one blank bar, and two rounded buttons, one grey and one teal. No text or numbers.

Non-blocking continuity note: Ananya sits in a blue upholstered chair here, but in 05-1 and 05-4 it is a dark grey office chair. The chair is not specified in the sections, and the faces, costumes and props all stay consistent, so I am not requiring a fix.
Read and looked at assets/panels/05-3.png, main-cast.png, page-05.png and the '05-3 ravi' crop on page-05-faces-200.png.

Doctor's-head edit: the upper-left area is clean plain white wall. I found no hair, shoulder or outline remnant of the removed back of Ananya's head. That plain area holds Ravi's balloon in the composite.

Ravi faces screen-left toward the doctor. His right hand, on the viewer's left, rubs the back of his neck with the rolled sleeve shown. His left hand, on the viewer's right, rests on his knee with the wristwatch on that wrist. This matches production and keeps the watch consistent with 05-1, 05-2 and 06-2. The face matches the sheet: beard, thick brows, eyes creasing at the corners.

Acting: his raised brows and open, sheepish smile with eyes glancing aside read as candid and slightly embarrassed. It is lighter than 'tired', but it suits a routine concern and implies nothing medical.

Screen: four stacked light blocks with person, clipboard-tick, chat and document icons, plus a row of three coloured chips on the left. A glowing teal microphone with sound-wave arcs sits in the right third. No letters, numbers or real data and nothing diagnostic. In the composite the SOAP label sits over the left blocks and the microphone stays visible.

Non-blocking spatial note: a window with a potted plant appears behind Ravi on the right, while 05-1 and 05-4 put the window behind Ananya. This reads acceptably as a side-wall window. His chair has blue upholstery with wooden arms, a little different from the blue frame in 05-1.
Read and looked at assets/panels/05-4.png, main-cast.png, page-05.png and the '05-4 ananya' crop on page-05-faces-200.png.

Over-the-shoulder framing is correct. The back of Ravi's head, with short dark hair and a beard edge at the cheek, and his green-shirted shoulder fill the lower right. Ananya sits across the desk, turned screen-right toward him, with a small nod-motion mark beside her head.

Her gaze is toward Ravi's head, not the laptop, with a soft closed-mouth smile. Face traits match: heavy-lidded almond eyes, level brows, gold stud, low bun. The coat, teal kurta and stethoscope around her neck are consistent with 05-1.

Her hands are folded together on the desk, one over the other, which reads as listening. At this size I cannot confirm which hand is on top (production says right over left), but the hands are not malformed and nothing is in them.
The laptop is open at the left edge with soft abstract cards and a small glowing microphone with wave marks. No text and no data.

White-block edit: the upper-right wall is an even plain wall with a faint light patch near the window and no flat rectangular artefact. In the composite that area holds the caption box. The window with trees and the heart-leaf plant behind her, plus her dark grey office chair, match 05-1.
Read and looked at assets/panels/06-1.png, main-cast.png and workflow/review/page-06.png. No face appears in this panel. I did not open storyboards/page-06.svg or the source text.

Close-up framing matches the scene. The dark bezel, the camera dot at the top centre, the hinge and the keyboard deck are visible. A window frame with greenery and plant leaves sit at the top right, a framed abstract picture with no text at the top left, a blue chair edge at the left and the wooden desk along the bottom.

Screen: a slim teal-outlined header bar left blank, then three tiles. Left: two arches of rounded teeth with two teeth tinted teal. Centre: an eye with three teal marker dots and leader lines. Right: a rising curve on a grid beside a card with three ticks and blank bars. Each tile has a plain band at the bottom. No letters, numbers or real patient data. In the composite the labels sit in those bands and the header.

Hand-move edit: one hand rests on the trackpad at the lower right, with a white coat sleeve and teal kurta cuff matching Ananya's costume. Fingers are well formed with no extra digits, and it stays clear of the paediatrician label in page-06.png. Her other hand is out of frame, as planned.

Non-blocking staging note: the hand enters from the reader's side of the screen, which implies Ananya is on the screen side. In 05-1 and 06-2 the screen is angled toward the reader, away from her. This is the request's own three-quarter convention and does not confuse the beat.
Read and looked at assets/panels/06-2.png, main-cast.png, page-06.png and page-06-faces-200.png.

The two-shot repeats the 05-1 staging. The laptop is in the left foreground, Ananya at centre behind the desk with the window and trailing pothos plant behind her, and Ravi at right. The plain upper wall holds the balloon in the composite.

Faces match the sheet on the 200% sheet. Ananya has heavy-lidded almond eyes, level brows, a gold stud and the low bun with strands. Ravi has his beard, thick brows and eyes creasing in a relaxed smile. Her stethoscope stays around her neck. There are no paper prescriptions and no instruments in use.

Hands match production. Ananya's left hand is an open palm toward Ravi and her right rests on the desk. Both of Ravi's hands rest on his knees, with the wristwatch on his left wrist, the viewer's right. The dark-brown shoulder bag leans beside his chair at the lower right, matching its position in 05-1 and the plan before he picks it up in 07-1.

Screen: five light cards showing a pill capsule, a document, a two-pill pair, a test tube and an arrow-out icon, each with blank bars. No text, no drug names and no data. The composite label covers the upper cards and the arrow-out card stays visible.

Non-blocking furniture continuity: Ananya's chair is blue upholstered here, as in 05-2, but dark grey in 05-1 and 05-4. Ravi's chair is a blue seat on metal legs here, but a blue armchair in 05-1. Identity, costume and prop continuity hold, so I am not requiring a fix.
